THE SCENE

You are in history class, solving a mystery about Bolivia. The mystery question is: when Bolivia got a new president, did the lithium rules change? Lithium is a metal used in phone and car batteries. You need four facts with dates for your mystery file. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This mystery is about Bolivia, a country in South America. Many Indigenous people there call the earth Mother Earth. In 2006 Evo Morales became president. He was Bolivia's first Indigenous president.
